svg.title: 6-stage equipment analysis pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Flowchart showing data flowing from Excel/JSON input through validation, rules engine, agent analysis, report building, and output stages

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the input loading stage — parser_excel.py and normalizer.py')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the validation stage — schemas.py and Pydantic')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the rules engine — severity classification, fault detection, priority bucketing')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the agent analysis stage — LangChain, EquipmentNarrative, the 3 tools, and the deterministic fallback')
g.text: Tools: threshold ref · fault library · style guide
Auto-fallback to deterministic on LLM failure

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about report_builder.py — FinalReport, metadata, thresholds, rows, and priority summaries')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about the output stage — docx_writer.py and JSON dump')

svg.text: If LLM fails at stage 4, the pipeline falls back to the deterministic rules from stage 3
